newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar futures end mixed, October dominates.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar futures end mixed, October dominates.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures ended mixed on Tuesday after front month August eased near the close and the October price went positive reducing the spread.
August expires on Wednesday. "There's still some untenderable sugar around," one trader said.
At the close most active October was up $0.10 at $317.00 and August was $0.10 easier at $326.60 for a closing spread of $9.60.
Volume on October was 1,596 lots, with 796 lots done on August.
